explanation: Spark feels proud. The clues are that he finished something tricky all by himself, and sat up tall with a smile.
title: Emotion Detectives: the tricky puzzle

visual.scenario: Spark worked on a very tricky puzzle for a long time. He tried and tried, and at last — click! — the final piece fit. Spark sat up tall and smiled.
visual.sceneAlt: A park scene. In the scene: white rabbit, brown dog.

reviewNote: Independent review passed with note: feeling Proud unambiguously cued and explanation clue-based; park scene is a loose illustration that does not depict the puzzle. Staging sample under the owner's 21 Nov 2026 direction.
